title: SSH Authorized Keys File Modified
detection_hypothesis: If key-based remote access persistence is installed, the authorized keys file for a user will be written.

field_semantics.TargetFilename: Absolute path of the file that was created or modified.
field_semantics.Image: Absolute path of the executable backing the created process.

collection_prerequisites: Audit watch rules cover the sensitive directories referenced by the rule.
The audit daemon is running and its rules survive reboot.
expected_collection_gaps: Directories without an explicit watch rule produce no events.
Bind-mounted paths inside containers may bypass host watches.
normalization_assumptions: TargetFilename is an absolute POSIX path.
Image identifies the writing process where the producer supplies it.
ingestion_differences: Path reconstruction from auditd PATH records varies between agents.
Relative paths may appear when the working directory record is missing.
retention_considerations: File watch telemetry is moderate volume; 90 days is a reasonable target.
false_positive_strategy: Benign writes come from configuration management or from a documented onboarding step. Tune on the writing process image and review the resulting key comment and fingerprint.
tuning_guidance: Exclude only the configuration agent absolute path. Do not exclude by user, since service account key files are the most sensitive of all.
test_strategy: Positive cases write the key file for a standard user and for a service account. Negative cases cover the configuration agent, the client configuration file, and a known hosts file.
author: Salvatore Mazzaglia
